segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, this is Dana at Northstar Packaging. We need to add 8 seats to our account before Monday. We're at 42 now, so moving to 50 total.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I can help with that. I have Northstar Packaging pulled up in the admin console. Just to confirm, this is for the Operations workspace on the annual plan, renewal date November 30, 2026?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. Same workspace, same plan. We just hired a few coordinators and want their logins ready for training.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. The 8 additional seats will be prorated through November 30. The billing tool is showing $1,146.72 plus applicable tax for the remainder of the term. Is it okay to apply that to the card ending in 1842?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that's fine. Can you also send the receipt to ap@northstarpackaging.com?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Absolutely. I added the 8 seats, so your seat limit is now 50. The charge went through, and I sent the receipt to ap@northstarpackaging.com. You should also see invoice INV-43871 in the billing section.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Do I need to do anything special to invite the new users?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No, you can invite them the usual way from Admin, then Users, then Invite users. Since the seats are active now, they can accept right away. If you upload a CSV, the knowledge base template is linked on that page.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. I see the new seat count now. Thanks for getting that done.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're welcome. I also noted ticket 247918 that the seats were added and the receipt was sent. You're all set.
